In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] [[Phoenix (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Phoenix'']] came under '''attack''' from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces while awaiting a rendezvous with the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Maximus]]'' and the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Ojai]]''. The Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were held off by the [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] until the ''Maximus'' arrived.

==Prelude==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] learned that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was working on a secret military construction project. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] devised a plan to learn more by tapping into the Imperial communications network. To this end, Rebel forces [[Ambush of the Phoenix|captured]] the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] [[Phoenix (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Phoenix'']] with its cargo of Imperial [[communications satellite]]s. The ''Phoenix'' was to rendezvous with the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Maximus]]'' and the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Ojai]]'', but their arrival was delayed.<ref name="XW" /> Not expecting any trouble, [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron's]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was dispatched in a lone<ref name="OSG" /> [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter]]<ref name="R22" /> to watch over the ''Phoenix'' until the ''Maximus'' arrived.<ref name="XW" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Finally, the ''Intrepid'' stopped launching TIEs. Then, when the ''Maximus'' arrived with the freighter ''Ojai'', the Star Destroyer simple departed. Could it be that the ''Intrepid'' is suffering and acute shortage of starfighters or pilots?|Keyan Farlander's after-action report|<ref name="OSG" />}}
Farlander emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to discover the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Intrepid (Imperial I-class)|''Intrepid'']] was already in the area. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] Farlander, forcing him to begin evasive maneuvers. Farlander kept the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] away from the ''Phoenix'' until the ''Maximus'' arrived with the ''Ojai''<ref name="OSG" /> and a [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], prompting the ''Intrepid'' to withdraw.<ref name="XW" />

==Aftermath==
The stolen satellites were transferred to the ''Ojai'', which [[Ambush in the Cron Drift|delivered]] them to the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Jeffrey]]. The satellites were deployed near the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] and later intercepted [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an Imperial [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] capable of destroying a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="XW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], in the fifth mission of "Tour of Duty II: The Great Search", "Protect Captured Satellites."<ref name="XW" />
